name: The Golem Workshop
realm: Gears whirr. Things are built here, one member at a time.
lesson: A struct bundles related variables into one new type. A class is the same, but members are private by default. A constructor has the class's name, no return type, and runs when an object is born; an initializer list (: hp(h)) sets members directly. Members are reached with a dot.

trial.explain: class = private by default, struct = public.

trial.prompt: What is the name of the constructor of class Golem?
Given Golem g; which accesses hp?

pool.prompt: Which keyword exposes the members after it to everyone?
pool.explain: public: opens members to all code.

boss.explain: Constructor sets n=0, two inc() calls.

boss.prompt: What does const after a member function's () promise?
options: a) it won't modify the object
d) it runs at compile time
boss.explain: const member functions can't change members.

options: a) members are initialized directly, not assigned later
b) it's the only way to name a constructor
boss.explain: Initializer lists construct members in place.

spell.prompt: Write struct Point with two int members, x and y.
spell.hint: struct Point { int x; int y; };  - don't forget the final ;
spell.explain: A struct is a custom type.
